en.title: Verify Android replay during an eight-car Rally start
en.body: The Android player guide records the measured bridge traffic, recording size and native replay cadence during a 210-frame driving sequence on a Galaxy Z Fold7, including steering, draw order and EGL recovery.

zh.title: 验证 Android 上八车起步时的驾驶录像
zh.body: Android 播放器指南记录了 Galaxy Z Fold7 上 210 帧驾驶中的桥接字节、录像大小和原生回放帧时，覆盖车辆转向、绘制顺序和 EGL 恢复。
